name: YakYak — patch scene dialogue, render via engine, deliver to Telegram

nodes.name: Patch request
nodes.notes: POST { movieId, dialogue, sceneNumber?, chatId?, token? }. Called by .github/workflows/patch-dialogue-to-telegram.yml — or anything else.

nodes.name: Call engine

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { target: { mode: 'patch', movieId: $json.movieId }, changes: { scenes: [ { sceneNumber: $json.sceneNumber, action: 'dialogue', dialogue: $json.dialogue } ] }, chatWebhookUrl: '' } }}

nodes.notes: The engine does everything: resolves the movie's campaign, applies update-scene-dialogue (subtitle→burn cascade, diff-aware — same line is a free no-op), waits, renders, responds { url, changed }. Retry is safe for the same reason. 45 min timeout.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { url: $json.url, movieId: $json.movieId, sceneNumber: $json.sceneNumber, dialogue: $json.dialogue, changed: $json.changed, delivered: $json.delivered } }}
